indicator_definition: NY.GDP.PCAP.KD: GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$); SP.POP.TOTL: population, total
transformation_policy: Retain annual 2000 values; prior computes log values, cross-country z-scores, and exp(0.15 * mean z).
acquisition_note: Official World Bank WDI 2000 responses downloaded 2026-08-08 from the indicator API/download endpoints; country rows with missing official values remain source-absent and are not imputed; benchmark execution reads only this frozen CSV and performs no network access.
